notes: Shared defaults. mode: off | shadow (log only) | recheck (needs a calibrated threshold from laya-eval.mjs). Per-machine overrides go to laya.local.json (gitignored). Env wins: XT_REVIEW_PR_LAYA, XT_REVIEW_PR_LAYA_THRESHOLD, LAYA_URL. mergeBlockThreshold: block the PR when Laya's P(Blocked) >= this (env XT_REVIEW_PR_LAYA_MERGE_BLOCK); chosen on 3 sets x 16 severity combinations, checked on a 4th.
